policy: 480P verification slice per the efficiency law: three representative shots (close-up / two-shot / landscape) burned at 672x384 int4 and read for motion and identity drift BEFORE any 768P production wave.
gate: same gate as packB-i2v; clips land in their own out dir so a verification file can never be mistaken for a production clip

units.lyric_anchor: 手牽手 一步兩步三步四步 望著天 (95.58-101.36)
units.note: Numbers-metre beat: the counting rhythm IS the shot, so the frame holds and the feet do the moving. Anchor = SHOTLIST v3 S3-17, frame = the C2145 re-roll that replaced the failed full-body two-shot.
units.verify_why: pack B close-up: counting feet, dense motion
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Locked-off low close-up on two pairs of feet. Two pairs of feet step along the faded white centre line in a counting rhythm, four shoes landing one after another, dusk dust lifting at each contact, the white paint bright underfoot. The camera stays still on the ground and lets the stepping carry the frame. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the warm dusk telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.lyric_anchor: 看星星 一顆兩顆三顆四顆 連成線 (209.36-214.68)
units.note: Line-closing hand hold (the motif that opened at S0-03). Longest B window; slowest speed so the hand contact reads before the cut to the final sky card.
units.verify_why: two-shot: face identity across a hand hold
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Steady close two-shot under the night sky. The two of them turn to face each other, her hand finding his, the thumbs pressing once before both hold, the shoulders settling a notch. Cool starlight falls on warm skin while a faint lamp edge warms the near cheek. The camera holds with a small drift, letting the pair breathe in one slow take. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the 2001 telecine palette. LIT_BY_NIGHT. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.verify_why: landscape: grass field holds under a slow drift
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Wide landscape under high noon sun. The golden grass field runs to the horizon on both sides of a faint white path, the stalks bending as a slow breeze crosses the field in one visible wave from the near edge to the far edge. The camera holds with a very small drift and lets the field breathe. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the 2001 telecine palette. LIT_BY_NOON. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look
